## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The command’s adoption output should be fixed because the new adoption records cause duplicate progress messages.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and a settings-count audit entry to returned plans. It adds tests for audit results and their omission from command output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit adoption progress once per setting in the command — Calling `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits it immediately, then the new adoption record reaches the rendering loop at `app/cli.py:9`, which emits it again. — Users running the command with existing settings receive duplicate adoption messages, making each adoption appear to happen twice.
